GANGADHAR NAGARALE Bengaluru, India • +91 7090013739 • gangadhar.nagarale.it@gmail.com https://www.linkedin.com/in/gangadhar-nagarale-it

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

ServiceNow Developer with 5.3 years of overall professional experience, including around 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow ITSM development. Skilled in platform customization, Flow Designer automation, Service Catalog development, scripting, and REST/SOAP integrations. Focused on delivering scalable solutions aligned with ServiceNow best practices and ITIL standards.

PROFILE SUMMARY

▪ ServiceNow Developer and Administrator with 5+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining

ITSM solutions within enterprise settings.

▪ Skilled in configuring and customizing essential core ITSM modules, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request,

Service Catalog, Knowledge, and CMDB, all in accordance with ITIL best practices.

▪ Experienced in managing Users, Groups, Roles, and Access Controls to ensure secure, role-based access and governance.

▪ Designed and implemented sophisticated Service Catalog items, Record Producers, Order Guides, and associated

workflows for automated fulfillment and multi-tiered approvals.

▪ Streamlined key ITSM processes by utilizing Flow Designer and Workflow Editor, facilitating efficient request handling

and operations.

▪ Proficient in scripting for both Client-side (Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions) and Server-side (Business Rules, Script

Includes, Scheduled Jobs) development.

▪ Managed deployments through Update Sets, ensuring version control and consistent configurations across various

environments.

▪ Established robust Access Control Rules (ACLs) at multiple levels to protect sensitive data and maintain compliance.

▪ Leveraged Import Sets and Transform Maps for structured data imports and integration with third-party data sources.

▪ Created insightful Reports, Dashboards, and Performance Analytics metrics to monitor SLAs, backlog trends, and overall

service performance.

▪

Integrated ServiceNow with third-party systems (e.g., monitoring tools, ticketing platforms) and implemented LDAP integration for automated user provisioning and authentication.

▪ Hands-on experience in customizing the Service Portal, including widget modifications and dynamic presentation of

catalog items.

▪ Effective in Agile/Scrum environments, demonstrating strong problem-solving abilities and collaboration with cross-

functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable solutions.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

▪ Client-Side Scripting: Client Scripts, UI Policies, Catalog Client Scripts, JavaScript.

▪ Server-Side Scripting: Business Rules, Script Includes, Scheduled Jobs, ACLs, UI Actions, Data Policies.

▪ Process Automation: Workflows, Workflow Studio, Flow Designer, Approval Rules, Notifications.

▪

Integration: REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, LDAP Integration.

▪

ITSM Modules: Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, SLA Management, CMDB.

▪ Service Catalog & Portal: Catalog Items, Record Producers, Variable Sets, Service Portal Widgets.

▪ Methodologies: Agile/Scrum, ITIL Framework.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

BIRLASOFT LTD, BENGALURU ServiceNow Developer – Trainee

SEPT-20 to JUL-22

MANIPAL TECHNOLOGIES PVT LTD, BENGALURU Software Engineer

JUL-22 to FEB-23

QUESS CORP PVT LTD, BENGALURU

JUL-23 to OCT-23

COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS, BENGALURU ServiceNow Developer

NOV-23 to PRESENT

PROJECTS

Client Name: ASM Technologies Ltd Role: ServiceNow Developer – (ITSM Implementation & Automation) Period: December-23 to November-24 Project Type: ITSM Implementation Team Size: 5 Description: End-to-end implementation of ServiceNow ITSM modules for ASM Technologies Limited, covering Incident, Problem, Change, Request Fulfilment, Service Catalog, and Knowledge Management, along with LDAP authentication and third-party system integrations, aligned with ITIL best practices.

Roles and Responsibilities:

▪ Designed and customized core ITSM modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Service Catalog, Knowledge,

and alignment with ITIL standards and business processes.

▪ Developed backend logic using Business Rules, Script Includes, Events, and Scheduled Jobs to support complex

automation and system behaviour.

▪ Built and maintained Service Catalog components such as Catalog Items, Record Producers, Order Guides, and multi-level

approval workflows.

▪ Automated request fulfilment and escalation processes using Flow Designer and legacy Workflows to improve operational

efficiency.

▪

Implemented secure access controls using ACLs at table, record, and field levels to ensure data security and compliance.

▪ Created Client Scripts, UI Policies, and UI Actions to enhance form behaviour and improve end-user experience.

▪ Managed Update Sets to migrate configurations and customizations across environments from Development to

Production.

▪ Performed data imports using Import Sets and Transform Maps for onboarding users and maintaining CMDB data.

▪

Integrated ServiceNow with external systems using REST and SOAP APIs, including monitoring, ticketing, and asset management tools.

▪ Supported LDAP integration for centralized authentication and automated user provisioning.

▪ Designed and delivered Reports, Dashboards, and Performance Analytics to track ITSM KPIs such as SLA compliance, ticket

trends, and volumes.

▪ Participated in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives while managing assigned

development tasks.

▪ Assisted in platform upgrades, performed regression testing, and ensured stability of custom applications and

configurations.

Client Name: ASM Technologies Ltd Role: ServiceNow Developer – Request Fulfilment, Service Catalog & Service Portal Customization Period: November-24 to December-25 Project Type: Request Fulfilment Service Portal Implementation Team Size: 5 Description: Implemented a ServiceNow Request Fulfilment Service Portal to enable employees to request IT services, software access, and hardware through standardized workflows, approvals, and automated fulfilment.

Roles and Responsibilities:

▪ Designed and implemented a Service Portal–based Request Fulfilment solution to enable employees to request software

access, hardware assets, and IT services through a single self-service interface.

▪ Developed and configured Service Catalog items, Record Producers, and Order Guides to standardize request submission

and improve user adoption.

▪ Designed multi-level approval workflows based on user role, department, cost centre, and request type to ensure

governance and compliance.

▪ Automated request routing, fulfilment tasks, and SLA tracking using Flow Designer and Workflows to reduce manual effort

and turnaround time.

▪ Created dynamic catalog variables, variable sets, and UI policies to capture accurate request information and enhance

portal usability.

▪

Implemented Client Scripts and UI Actions to provide real-time validations, auto-population, and conditional field visibility.

▪ Configured ACLs and user criteria to control catalog visibility and ensure secure access to services and data. Integrated the Request Fulfilment process with asset and user data to support hardware provisioning and software access requests.

▪ Built fulfilment task flows for resolver groups to track progress, assignments, and completion status.

▪ Developed reports and dashboards to monitor request volumes, approval turnaround time, SLA compliance, and

fulfilment performance.

▪ Managed Update Sets to migrate portal customizations, catalog items, and workflows across DEV, TEST, and PROD

environments.

▪ Supported UAT, resolved production issues, and collaborated with stakeholders to continuously enhance the Service

Portal experience.

Client Name: ASM Technologies Ltd Role: ServiceNow Developer – ITSM Process Optimization, SLA Automation & Service Catalog Integration Period: December-25 to Present Project Type: ITSM Optimization & Integration Team Size: 5 Description: Optimized ServiceNow incident management and SLA tracking to reduce resolution times and breaches, while integrating the Service Catalog with Integration Hub and CMDB to automate asset record updates for provisioning requests, aligned with ITIL best practices.

Roles and Responsibilities:

▪ Configured automated assignment rules and multi-stage workflows using Flow Designer to route incidents instantly.

▪ Established dynamic SLA definitions and built Performance Analytics dashboards to track team resolution bottlenecks.

▪ Designed a user-friendly Service Catalog with automated approval workflows for software and hardware requests.

▪ Utilized Integration Hub to automatically update asset records within the CMDB upon successful provisioning.

▪ Reduced mean time to resolution (MTTR) by 25% and improved SLA compliance from 78% to 94%.

▪ Accelerated employee provisioning time from 5 days to under 4 hours, eliminating manual data entry errors.

CERTIFICATION

▪ Micro-Certification - Flow Designer

▪ Micro-Certification - Welcome to ServiceNow

▪ Micro-Certification - Integration Hub

▪ Micro-Certification - Service Portal

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Computer Application (2020)

Rani Channamma University, Belagavi

PERSONAL DETAILS

Name: Gangadhar Nagarale

DOB: 05/06/1999

DECLARATION

I hereby declare that all the information is true to the best of my knowledge & I bear the responsibility for the correctness of the mentioned particulars.

▪ Automated request fulfilment and escalation processes using Flow Designer and legacy Workflows to improve operational
efficiency.
▪
Implemented secure access controls using ACLs at table, record, and field levels to ensure data security and compliance.
▪ Created Client Scripts, UI Policies, and UI Actions to enhance form behaviour and improve end-user experience.
▪ Managed Update Sets to migrate configurations and customizations across environments from Development to
Production.
▪ Performed data imports using Import Sets and Transform Maps for onboarding users and maintaining CMDB data.
▪
Integrated ServiceNow with external systems using REST and SOAP APIs, including monitoring, ticketing, and asset management tools.
▪ Supported LDAP integration for centralized authentication and automated user provisioning.
▪ Designed and delivered Reports, Dashboards, and Performance Analytics to track ITSM KPIs such as SLA compliance, ticket
trends, and volumes.
▪ Participated in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives while managing assigned
development tasks.
▪ Assisted in platform upgrades, performed regression testing, and ensured stability of custom applications and
configurations.
Client Name: ASM Technologies Ltd Role: ServiceNow Developer – Request Fulfilment, Service Catalog & Service Portal Customization Period: November-24 to December-25 Project Type: Request Fulfilment Service Portal Implementation Team Size: 5 Description: Implemented a ServiceNow Request Fulfilment Service Portal to enable employees to request IT services, software access, and hardware through standardized workflows, approvals, and automated fulfilment.
Roles and Responsibilities:
▪ Designed and implemented a Service Portal–based Request Fulfilment solution to enable employees to request software
access, hardware assets, and IT services through a single self-service interface.
▪ Developed and configured Service Catalog items, Record Producers, and Order Guides to standardize request submission
and improve user adoption.
▪ Designed multi-level approval workflows based on user role, department, cost centre, and request type to ensure
governance and compliance.
▪ Automated request routing, fulfilment tasks, and SLA tracking using Flow Designer and Workflows to reduce manual effort
and turnaround time.
▪ Created dynamic catalog variables, variable sets, and UI policies to capture accurate request information and enhance
portal usability.
▪
Implemented Client Scripts and UI Actions to provide real-time validations, auto-population, and conditional field visibility.
▪ Configured ACLs and user criteria to control catalog visibility and ensure secure access to services and data. Integrated the Request Fulfilment process with asset and user data to support hardware provisioning and software access requests.
▪ Built fulfilment task flows for resolver groups to track progress, assignments, and completion status.
▪ Developed reports and dashboards to monitor request volumes, approval turnaround time, SLA compliance, and
fulfilment performance.
▪ Managed Update Sets to migrate portal customizations, catalog items, and workflows across DEV, TEST, and PROD
environments.
▪ Supported UAT, resolved production issues, and collaborated with stakeholders to continuously enhance the Service
Portal experience.
Client Name: ASM Technologies Ltd Role: ServiceNow Developer – ITSM Process Optimization, SLA Automation & Service Catalog Integration Period: December-25 to Present Project Type: ITSM Optimization & Integration Team Size: 5 Description: Optimized ServiceNow incident management and SLA tracking to reduce resolution times and breaches, while integrating the Service Catalog with Integration Hub and CMDB to automate asset record updates for provisioning requests, aligned with ITIL best practices.
Roles and Responsibilities:
▪ Configured automated assignment rules and multi-stage workflows using Flow Designer to route incidents instantly.
▪ Established dynamic SLA definitions and built Performance Analytics dashboards to track team resolution bottlenecks.
▪ Designed a user-friendly Service Catalog with automated approval workflows for software and hardware requests.
▪ Utilized Integration Hub to automatically update asset records within the CMDB upon successful provisioning.
▪ Reduced mean time to resolution (MTTR) by 25% and improved SLA compliance from 78% to 94%.
▪ Accelerated employee provisioning time from 5 days to under 4 hours, eliminating manual data entry errors.
